_note: Channel catalog. Every channel starts NOT connected. 'filters' lists what the platform's own interface is generally known to offer, and is a planning hint only: confirm it in your own account before relying on it. MARK never claims a search ran unless a search is logged with evidence. 'approved': true marks channels the recruiter asked to be in every campaign's default selection. 'string_type' picks which of MARK's strings the plan hands to that channel (boolean, xray, github).

channels.name: LinkedIn Recruiter
channels.methodology: Recruiter search with title, skills, company and location facets; save searches and project pipelines.

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.methodology: Standard people search with Boolean keywords; Google X-Ray as a complement.

channels.name: Naukri
channels.methodology: Resdex keyword search with experience, CTC, notice period and location filters.

channels.name: Instahyre
channels.methodology: Candidate search by skills, experience and company; active seekers.

channels.name: iimjobs
channels.methodology: Senior and management search; often used for leadership roles.

channels.name: GitHub
channels.methodology: User search by language and location; repositories by topic; contributors to relevant repos. Evidence is code, not job history.

channels.name: Stack Overflow
channels.methodology: Top users by tag and location via X-Ray; evidence is answers, not employment.

channels.name: Google X-Ray
channels.methodology: site: searches on public profile pages (linkedin.com/in, github.com, stackoverflow.com/users). Only shows public, indexed pages.

channels.name: Google Search
channels.methodology: Conference speakers, blog authors, meetup organisers, open-source maintainers.

channels.name: Internal ATS
channels.methodology: Rediscover past applicants and silver medallists for the same skills.

channels.name: Employee referrals
channels.methodology: Share the requirement with teams who worked with the target companies.

channels.name: Common Room
channels.methodology: Community and signal data, where your workspace has it.

channels.name: Clay
channels.methodology: Enrichment and list building on records you already have, within your plan and terms.

channels.name: Company career portals
channels.methodology: Read target companies' job pages to see which teams use the stack and are hiring.

channels.name: Professional communities
channels.methodology: Meetups, Slack/Discord groups, conference speaker lists.

channels.name: Recruiter databases
channels.methodology: Your own spreadsheets and past campaign ledgers.

channels.name: The Org
channels.methodology: People and role search by company and title through the connector, when connected in the session (max 25 results per search; uses credits).

channels.name: OctoHunt
channels.methodology: Recruiter-chosen portal for finding developers. MARK hands it the GitHub-style query (language, location, skill topics). Features, limits and terms are unconfirmed until first use: record what the portal actually offers.

channels.name: SourceGo
channels.methodology: Recruiter-chosen sourcing portal. MARK hands it the Google X-Ray strings (LinkedIn, Open to Work, GitHub, Stack Overflow, resume pages). Features are unconfirmed until first use: record what the portal actually offers.
